## Background

<!-- Optional. Inline math goes between single dollar signs; a display equation
between double dollar signs. LaTeX syntax:
https://www.overleaf.com/learn/latex/Mathematical_expressions -->

Broad-sense heritability is $H^2 = \sigma_G^2 / \sigma_P^2$. Under the classic
one-way model, the phenotype of individual $j$ in genotype $i$ is

$$
y_{ij} = \mu + g_i + e_{ij}, \qquad g_i \sim N(0, \sigma_G^2),\; e_{ij} \sim N(0, \sigma_e^2).
$$

## Analysis

<!-- One runnable chunk per idea. `#| label:` names the chunk, `#| fig-cap:`
captions the figure. Add `#| echo: false` to hide code entirely, or
`#| eval: false` to show code without running it. Always set a seed so
readers can reproduce your numbers. -->

```{r}
#| label: fig-heritability
#| fig-cap: "Simulated broad-sense heritability by trait across trial years"
#| warning: false

library(ggplot2)

set.seed(42)
traits <- rep(c("Yield", "Plant Height", "Disease Score", "Days to Maturity"), each = 5)
year <- rep(2020:2024, times = 4)
heritability <- runif(20, 0.25, 0.9)

df <- data.frame(trait = traits, year = year, heritability = heritability)

ggplot(df, aes(x = year, y = heritability, color = trait)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Trial year", y = expression(H^2), color = "Trait") +
  theme_minimal()
```
